title: ZENTRALE building kit: port types, pieces, wires, sketches, generations (major 1)
description: One schema file with every item of the building kit (memory/hub/building_kit_plan.md 1 and 6.7; reasoning: memory/hub/port_types.md). Validate an item against `{"$ref": "urn:zentrale:ports:1#/$defs/<item>"}` or the same document with a top-level `$ref`. Terms follow TOSCA v2.0 (node types = piece kinds, capabilities = offers, requirements = needs, relationship types, occurrences) and NetBox for the physical layers (interface, cable, power port). Within major 1 only additive changes (plan 2.2 rule 1).

portType.description: A port type: a registered family, optionally with a qualifier for the families that take one (event:calendar-changed, tile:list, read:calendar).

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 core version (no pre-release, no build).

range.description: A SemVer range, npm style subset: ^1, ^1.2, ~1.2, an exact 1.2.3, or * (any).

requirementString.description: Short form of a need: type, optionally @range (sync@^1).

capabilityString.description: Short form of an offer: type, optionally @version (sync@1.0.0).

occurrences.description: TOSCA occurrences [min, max]; max may be "UNBOUNDED".

need.description: A requirement (TOSCA). `id` names the socket on the piece (default: the type); `range` the accepted versions of the type (default ^<major the registry knows>); `occurrences` how many wires it takes (default from the registry); `access` read or write for data-like types.

legacy.description: Read from the old keys (rechte/liefert): granted by the rights check, not enforced by the compiler until the plug dialog wires it.

offer.description: A capability (TOSCA). `id` names the socket (default: the type); `version` the version of the type it speaks (default: the registry's).

manifestPorts.description: The port part of an app manifest (app.toml read as JSON, or a built-in app in core/eingebaute_apps.py). Other manifest keys are not this contract's business.

typeEntry.description: One port type family in the registry.

relationship.description: TOSCA normative relationship type of a wire of this type.

scope.description: Who owns a wire of this type (plan 1.4): node = the node the consumer is stationed on, counted per node; instance = the consumer piece, synced; link = observed/documented connection between nodes and devices.

netbox.description: The NetBox term for the physical layers.

piece.description: A piece (TOSCA node template): a node (with its platform ports: hardware, local calendar, folders), an app instance, a device without ZENTRALE. `ref` is the real object's address — never a copy.

on.description: Nodes this piece is stationed on (apps).

managed.description: Nodes: runs the apply agent. False = unmanaged, read-only, never targeted.

types.description: Nodes: the port type versions this node supports (from its node description).

role.description: Devices: NetBox device role (router, switch, printer, power-bank …).

owns.description: Resources this piece is the one owner of (file:data/lists.json).

wire.description: One connection from an offered port to a needed port of the same type (plan 1.4).

generation.description: A compiled sketch: self-contained, hashed (sha256 over the JCS form of format + pieces + wires).
